name: Gloom and Doom
source:
Gloom is an ancient wraith trying to earn his way into Heaven by killing demons for an exploitative angel. Wynona is a depressed young girl who is convinced she is the Doom Bringer that will end the world.

His final task is to kill her and she's trying to die - it should be a match made in heaven. But here's the catch: She's unkillable. Gloom and Wynona will have to deal with the agents of both Heaven and Hell if they are going to discover their destinies and escape from their empty and repetitive lives.

And then there's the big dilemma: Should you save the world from a demon apocalypse, or save her soul?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
格鲁姆是一个古老的怨灵，为一位压榨他的天使猎杀恶魔，试图以此换取进入天堂的资格。薇诺娜则是个饱受抑郁困扰的少女，坚信自己就是将会终结世界的“末日使者”。

他的最后一个任务，是杀死她，而她正一心求死，这本该是天作之合。可问题在于，她根本杀不死。为了弄清自己的命运，摆脱空虚而重复的生活，格鲁姆和薇诺娜必须与天堂和地狱双方的使者周旋。

而后，还有一个两难的抉择。在恶魔引发的末日中拯救世界，还是拯救她的灵魂？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372800/]Steam[/url]]
